name: Mafia Trends Limited
summary: Mafia Trends Limited functions as a specialized apparel retailer within India, providing a broad selection of textile goods. Its extensive men's clothing line features various t-shirts (including polo styles), casual and formal shirts, traditional kurtas, sweaters, Nehru jackets, jeans, formal and casual trousers, capris, shorts, and winter attire. The company also supplies children's wear, encompassing t-shirts, shirts, shorts, jeans, trousers, and party outfits. These products are retailed through the company's dedicated stores, operating under the brand name 'Mafia'. Established in 2008, the firm is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
